question: What is the shortcut to open an MS PowerPoint file directly from the application?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + O**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ctrl + O** is the shortcut key to open a file in Microsoft PowerPoint directly from the application interface.
 
• This shortcut works universally across Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
 
• Using **Ctrl + O**, users can quickly access the file explorer to locate and open an existing presentation file.
 
• It enhances productivity by eliminating the need to navigate through multiple menus manually.
 
• The shortcut is applicable for all versions of Microsoft PowerPoint, including Office 365, 2019, 2016, and older versions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microsoft PowerPoint:**

 
 
• Microsoft PowerPoint is a presentation software developed by Microsoft as part of the Office Suite.
 
• It allows users to create slideshows composed of text, images, videos, and animations.
 
• PowerPoint is widely used for business presentations, educational purposes, and personal projects.
 
• The software is compatible with both Windows and macOS operating systems.
 
 
 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts:**
 
 
• Keyboard shortcuts are predefined key combinations that perform specific tasks in software applications.
 
• Common shortcuts in PowerPoint include **Ctrl + S** (Save), **Ctrl + N** (New Presentation), and **Ctrl + P** (Print).
 
• They are designed to improve efficiency and streamline workflow for users.
 
 
 
• **File Formats in PowerPoint:**
 
 
• Microsoft PowerPoint primarily uses the **.pptx** file format for saving presentations.
 
• Older versions of PowerPoint saved files in the **.ppt** format.
 
• It also supports exporting presentations as PDF, video files, or image formats.
 
 
 
• **Office Integration:**
 
 
• Microsoft PowerPoint integrates seamlessly with other Office applications like Word, Excel, and Outlook.
 
• Users can embed Excel charts, Word tables, and multimedia content directly into their presentations.
 
• Collaboration features allow multiple users to edit presentations simultaneously using Office 365.
